title: A comprehensive study on the structure, microstructure and electrical properties of a Dy-doped LaBiO3 ceramic for thermistor application
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,5535-5547
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06969F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Chandan Kumar Lenka, S. K. Parida
In this work, the synthesis of dysprosium (Dy)-substituted lanthanum bismuth oxide (LaBi0.95Dy0.05O3, LBDO) via solid-state reaction and its structural, microstructural, dielectric, and conductivity characterizations are systematically investigated.
